analysisSummary: The facility connects financiers, implementation partners, producer organizations, SMEs, aggregators, logistics providers, and market off-takers into a single agricultural inclusion network.

edges.notes: Catalytic capital supports policy-led agricultural transformation
Coordinates farmer onboarding, input distribution, and advisory services
Supports SME readiness, compliance, and market entry
Finances aggregation, seasonal input purchase, and inventory conversion
Expands access to credit for women-led processing enterprises
Provides accounts, merchant services, and short-tenor lending
Connects rural merchants to payment rails and savings products
Aggregated produce flows into local processing and market access
Processed goods move through local merchant channels
SMEs settle invoices and receive merchant payments through bank rails

edges.relationship: Risk sharing and local currency support
edges.notes: Supports a Zambian Kwacha-denominated guarantee to crowd in private capital
Supports the $100 million expansion programme through local currency risk sharing
Expands crop supply, livestock sourcing, and offtake relationships
Connects crop production to feed milling, flour processing, livestock, and meat products
Processed goods move into regional retail and informal trade channels
